title: Sunday Reset at Vibiana: Yoga & Soundbath
description: Join Alice, Anita & Emily for a yoga practice + soundbath at historic Vibiana. Stay for brunch at Redbird for a perfect Sunday reset.
long_description:
Join Alice, Anita & Emily for a yoga practice + soundbath at historic Vibiana. Stay for brunch at Redbird for a perfect Sunday reset.

About this Event

Yoga + Sound at Vibiana - in partnership with North Ray Yoga x Redbird LA

There are some spaces that ask you to slow down the moment you enter them. Vibiana is one of them.

Join us for a Sunday morning practice inside the historic cathedral - beginning with an all-levels yoga practice led by Alice Toyonaga, then settling into sound, voice and vibration with Anita Vasan and Emily Morwen.

A chance to move, breathe, listen and experience this extraordinary space in a completely different way.

Come for the practice. Head on over to Redbird for brunch after - an iconic Sunday reset in DTLA. To reserve brunch post yoga, please click here . 

No experience needed. Bring a mat and come as you are.

Alice Toyonaga is a yoga teacher, Reiki Master, writer, teacher mentor and co-founder of North Ray Yoga. For more than 20 years, she has explored movement and healing through an approach that blends science, intuition, Buddhist philosophy, trauma-informed care, and nervous system education. With over 2,000 hours of training, Alice teaches across yoga, breathwork, Reiki, and sound, inviting people to move beyond control and into deeper listening. @alicetoyonagawellness
Anita Vasan is a meditation and yoga teacher whose work explores the transformative power of breath, stillness, sound, and presence. Drawing from extensive study in India, silent meditation retreats, and training in New York and LA, she weaves ancient contemplative traditions into modern life. Anita specializes in Yoga Nidra and incorporates her voice, sound, and healing chants into warm, experiential practices that invite deeper rest and connection. @anitavasan
